how_this_is_used: A PIM hit NEVER produces advice and NEVER reaches the elder.
It sets a flag that BLOCKS schedule generation and routes the item to the adult child for manual confirmation (spec §7.3).
The wording shown to the adult child is a neutral prompt to ask the doctor — never a recommendation to change anything.
